verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents running the full product (MongoDB, the API and the front-end) on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, and describes itself as open source with an optional cloud offering. A user reports running the self-hosted version in production, and a runtime probe booted the official Docker image keylessly and completed a flag create-and-evaluate loop with no account or license. Missing for 10: a documented non-Docker install path (one user asked for one for shared hosting), and evidence that paid-tier features are available when self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
